description: This Java source file defines the LogFragment class, a Fragment subclass that manages a LogView within a ScrollView to display log data in an Android application. It includes methods for view creation, layout setup, and handling text changes to auto-scroll the log view.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays a log view within a scrollable layout, handling view inflation and text change events to facilitate log display.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the ScrollView and LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, padding, and adding the LogView to the ScrollView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the views, sets up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll on text changes, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
